svg.aria-label: Where the product sits in the Blue Rewards system. The product is a dedicated space inside the existing Blue Rewards app, nested within the programme systems of record, which are nested within BMO. The member is to the left, evidence authorities to the right, and forces outside the boundary across the top. The product owns no system of record.
svg.text: TEAM ZIG · BLUE REWARDS · SYSTEMS MAP
An enhanced experience within Blue Rewards

g.text: privacy law, consent rules, suitability, disclosure
PC Optimum, Scene, bank and card ecosystems
a member, a BMO client, or both
what the enhancement is built around
What the programme records is what a member did
inside it, not everything they bought or wanted.
Owns Blue Rewards and funds it. Emerging Business, in gold, is our client. Each of the other teams holds a decision we would need.
carries the cost of points held
The loyalty programme itself: the offers, the points, the catalogue, and the people who resolve cases.
We would read from these services and write back to them. We would not replace any of them.
WHAT WE ARE PROPOSING TO BUILD
A dedicated space inside the Blue Rewards app and website.
Blue, the optional conversational assistant, works across all four and shares the same saved information
The programme still runs the offers, the points and the rewards. What we would own is whether the member understands them.
The only new records we would create
A saved goal · a saved comparison · ranked options with the reason for the ranking · a case the member can follow
No single one sees a whole journey, so when value goes missing the
proof is split between them. We would ask all five and instruct none.
writes the eligibility rules, the reward amount and the deadlines
the only party that sees what was actually in the basket
sees a merchant and an amount, and decides when it settles
ties an online click or a photographed receipt to the member
ships the gift card, books the trip, decides when it arrives
each reports on its own timetable
cases routed to whoever is responsible

Underneath, value moves through the five stages on the systems map. This enhancement does not move value itself — existing Blue Rewards services and partners still do that. It changes whether the member can see, judge, follow and recover it.
WHAT THIS ENHANCEMENT DOES NOT REPLACE
• Existing earning methods: partner scans, linked-card offers, receipts, Shops and BMO products.
• Redemption fulfilment: gift cards, travel, merchandise and partner redemptions.
• BMO and partner support where manual investigation or partner action is required.
• Partner issuance, redemption and reversal: those services need partner credentials, not a member session.
